mapper.select: SELECT W.WAVE_ID AS WAVE_ID, W.WAVE_NAME AS WAVE_NAME, W.SEQUENCE_NO AS SEQUENCE_NO, W.PLANNED_START AS PLANNED_START, W.PLANNED_END AS PLANNED_END, W.STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD, W.REMARK AS REMARK, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_IF_MIGRATION_PLAN_PILOT P WHERE P.WAVE_ID = W.WAVE_ID) AS PLAN_CNT FROM TB_IF_MIGRATION_WAVE_PILOT W ORDER BY W.SEQUENCE_NO, W.WAVE_ID

SELECT WAVE_ID AS WAVE_ID, WAVE_NAME AS WAVE_NAME, SEQUENCE_NO AS SEQUENCE_NO, PLANNED_START AS PLANNED_START, PLANNED_END AS PLANNED_END, STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD, REMARK AS REMARK FROM TB_IF_MIGRATION_WAVE_PILOT WHERE WAVE_ID = #{waveId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_IF_MIGRATION_WAVE_PILOT WHERE WAVE_ID = #{waveId}
SELECT PLAN_ID AS PLAN_ID, WAVE_ID AS WAVE_ID, TARGET_TYPE_CD AS TARGET_TYPE_CD, TARGET_ID AS TARGET_ID, STRATEGY_7R_CD AS STRATEGY_7R_CD FROM TB_IF_MIGRATION_PLAN_PILOT

SELECT RELATION_ID AS RELATION_ID, FROM_TYPE_CD AS FROM_TYPE_CD, FROM_ID AS FROM_ID, TO_TYPE_CD AS TO_TYPE_CD, TO_ID AS TO_ID, RELATION_TYPE_CD AS RELATION_TYPE_CD FROM TB_IF_ASSET_RELATION_PILOT WHERE CRITICAL_YN = 'Y'
